newsitem.title: UK: UK's Gallaher plays down tobacco litigation fears.
newsitem.headline: UK's Gallaher plays down tobacco litigation fears.

text.p: Gallaher Group Plc, the UK tobacco firm which is to demerge from American Brands Inc, on Friday played down fears of big damage payments resulting from litigation proceedings in Britain.
The company, which aims for a London Stock Market listing on May 30, stressed it has no business in the U.S. and that it faces no claims from that country.
Chief executive and chairman Peter Wilson also emphasized that the litigation "climate" here is much milder than in the U.S.
"It is very important to understand that the situation here is completely different than in the U.S.," he added.
Gallaher said it faces several proceedings in Britain brought against it by people alleging they have contracted lung cancer as a result of smoking tobacco products.
"The pending actions and claims will be vigorously contested," Gallaher said in its introduction prospectus.
Wilson said Gallaher has made unspecified provisions for the litigation fees.
